message:
The logs are empty. The build may have failed or is still running. Let me check if the background process is still running and check the logs.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>ps aux | grep -E "cmake|make" | grep -v grep | head; echo "---"; wc -l /tmp/cmake_build.log /tmp/make_build.log 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; cat /tmp/cmake_build.log 2>/dev/null | head -20</｜｜DSML｜｜>
